KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES — MOCK EXAM #13
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Msamiati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Msamiati.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Msamiati.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Msamiati.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Msamiati.

2. Wingi wa “mtoto” ni: (1 mark)
   A. kitoto
   B. mitoto
   C. watoto
   D. mato

3. When practising herufi kubwa, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for herufi kubwa.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to herufi kubwa.
   C. Use insults to “practise” herufi kubwa.
   D. Copy random text without understanding herufi kubwa.

4. Ni sentensi ipi iliyo sahihi kisarufi? (1 mark)
   A. Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.
   B. Mwanafunzi anasoma vitabu mzuri.
   C. Anasoma mwanafunzi kitabu ya.
   D. Kitabu anasoma mwanafunzi kwa.

5. When practising Masimulizi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Masimulizi.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Masimulizi.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Masimulizi.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Masimulizi.

6. Kinyume cha “refu” ni: (1 mark)
   A. pana
   B. zito
   C. fupi
   D. nene

7. When practising Anga, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Anga.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Anga.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Anga.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Anga.

8. When practising Hadithi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Hadithi.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Hadithi.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Hadithi.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Hadithi.

9. When practising Huyo na Hao, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Huyo na Hao.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Huyo na Hao.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Huyo na Hao.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Huyo na Hao.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
10. In three clear sentences, explain Masimulizi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

11. In three clear sentences, explain thi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Hili na Haya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Nambari 11-50 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Msamiati and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Masimulizi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
